annotations.title: Show the prompt and its references

description: Displays a supplied adapted video prompt first, followed by the credited catalog videos and original prompts used as references, with their localized site thumbnails. Can also show references alone. Retrieves published references by id; does not generate videos or save the supplied draft.

generated_prompt.description: Complete copy-ready new draft adapted to the user, without headings, credits or commentary. Omit when only showing existing examples.

language.description: Language of the user, as a code such as fr, es, ja, zh, zh-tw (50 languages). Titles, summaries and links come in this language, and fetch adds the translated prompt. Defaults to en.

reference_ids.description: Ids or Promptcelerator page URLs returned by search or fetch.
